title: Indie Thinkers Launches Human-Curated Platform for Essays and Tech News Curation
description: Los Angeles, California, United States, October 16, 2026 /MarketersMEDIA/ -- Indie Thinkers has launched a collection of human-curated tools designed to surface written content and technology news without relying on automated generation. title: How Water Intelligence Could Be India's Next Industrial Advantage
description: India’s next phase of industrial growth will depend on how intelligently businesses use resources such as water, energy and materials, rather than simply expanding capacity. Connected sensors, advanced analytics and artificial intelligence can help companies optimise resource use, predict operational problems and improve efficiency, resilience and sustainability. Water intelligence can strengthen India’s industrial competitiveness by reducing costs, improving operational reliability and helping businesses manage resource-related risks.

title: Pitched 2 ideas to PM Modi in 90 seconds on Chennai Metro: Who is AI startup founder Tejas Sudarshan & what did he propose?
description: Chennai-based startup founder Tejas Parthasarathi Sudarshan pitched two artificial intelligence ideas to Prime Minister Narendra Modi during a Chennai Metro journey, getting around 90 seconds to present his proposals. The Winsen Labs founder suggested connecting students with real-world government projects and creating a unified AI-powered platform to simplify access to public services. He was among 17 startup founders shortlisted by SPI Chennai for the interaction.
